=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:25-144 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new test file tests/test_orchestrate_stall_active_runs_cache.py is not named in any `.github/workflows/*.yml` file and has no `UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST` entry; its cases reach CI only through the collector in tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py (lines 741-757), and the guard does not accept that route.
  WHY: The required `quick / static-checks` check fails `test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow` on head 504a5cc9 at tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:141, which blocks the merge; all three reviewers rated it BLOCKER, mapped here to critical.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22759-22786 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new held branch in `invoke_stall_judge` (22761-22765) never reads the stored `judge_escalate_streak`, so `_judge_escalate_streak` stays at 0 and the backstop check `[ "${_judge_escalate_streak}" -ge "${MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY}" ]` (22781-22782) cannot fire.
  WHY: With `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION` at its default of false, `effective_action` falls through to `normalize_stall_recovery_action`, which turns `escalate_human` into `retrigger_review` for ai:done. The `STALL_SKIP ... reason=active_set_unverifiable` hold (20413-20416) is then never reached, and the poller dispatches a review retrigger on an unverifiable tick (the #557/#559 failure class). All three reviewers rated it MAJOR, mapped here to high. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash separately argues this matches pre-PR behavior and is not a regression (see its separate finding below).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22761-22765 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The hold-branch comment and the agents.d `ACTIONS_RUNS_SELF_CHECK` contract say a held judge escalation logs `STALL_SKIP ... reason=active_set_unverifiable`. In the default configuration with a below-cap streak, however, `normalize_stall_recovery_action` converts `escalate_human` to the ladder action (`retrigger_review`) before `execute_stall_recovery_action`, so no hold line is printed.
  WHY: Operators who rely on the comment or the agents.d registry cannot diagnose unverifiable ticks reliably from logs. The reviewer frames this as a comment/contract accuracy defect, not a behavior regression (rated NIT, mapped here to low).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18302 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_ensure_actions_runs_blob_has_self_run` resets `_ACTIONS_RUNS_BLOB_READY` to 'false' but does not guarantee it is set back to 'true' after the forced refetch in every edge case.
  WHY: The loader could run again within the same tick, which might log `ACTIONS_RUNS_SOURCE` twice or leave the state wrong. Rated NIT, mapped here to low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash each rejected this claim: every non-memo return path of `_load_actions_runs_cached`, including no_repo, sets the flag to "true".
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The PR acceptance table lists "test (red-on-base) | tests/test_orchestrate_stall_active_runs_cache.py", and the linked issue's files_touched names that file. It has to run in CI, or be allowlisted by the CI wiring guard, to count as delivered.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST (lines 25-106; precedent at lines 34-37), or a reference in .github/workflows/ci.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Neither the PR diff nor the last-run diff touches tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py or any .github/workflows/*.yml file, and grep over `.github/` finds no reference to `test_orchestrate_stall_active_runs_cache`. The `quick / static-checks` check on head 504a5cc9b8ae6c635f5f6e0f4760f92ae46af386 fails at tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:141 naming this file. The cases are collected only through tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py:741-757, which `_is_wired` (lines 134-135) does not accept. The allowlist file is outside the issue's files_touched grant (#9487/#9418 precedents).
- requirement: "If the live refetch also fails, stall recovery does not escalate on an empty active set during that tick (fail safe, logged with its own reason)." The agents.d entry adds that escalate_human is held as `STALL_SKIP ... reason=active_set_unverifiable` and that other stall actions are unchanged.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh invoke_stall_judge, held branch at lines 22761-22765
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The last run's held branch zeroes the streak that decides escalation. When the stored streak would have forced escalate_human, the code runs the normalized ladder action (retrigger_review) instead of the held escalate_human / STALL_SKIP outcome. No test runs invoke_stall_judge with STALL_ACTIVE_SET_UNVERIFIABLE=true and a stored streak.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22759-22786 (invoke_stall_judge; held branch 22761-22765) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The held branch leaves `_judge_escalate_streak` at 0, so the `-ge MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY` check at 22781-22782 falls through to `normalize_stall_recovery_action` at line 22785. With `ENABLE_STALL_HUMAN_TERMINALIZATION` defaulting to false, `resolve_effective_stall_recovery_action` (lines 19258-19276) maps escalate_human for ai:done to retrigger_review, and line 22831 runs that action instead of the hold.
